name: chat-composer
title: Composer
description: The person's message: the chips the host attaches (on the board, unsent notes and selected cards), each removable, the host's context chip that opens to its lines (on the board, the answers since the last Send), the text and Send, and one line under it with the keys, why Send waits, or why the composer is shut (the Architect composer).

files.core: composer-core.ts (composerView, sendIntent, chipKey, withoutChip, ComposerContext, COMPOSER_KEYS; no DOM)

states: with the context, closed and open
holding: what is attached waits for the turn to end

attributes.data-shut: the host's blocked reason applies: the text can't be typed in

methods.show(view): Send allowed, the line, the placeholder, shut or not (from composerView)
methods.setContext(context): the host's context { label, lines } beside the chips, or null; it is not removable and goes with every message the host sends
methods.clear(): empties the words and the chips once the message went through
methods.text, chips, attached, focusText(): the words typed, the chips, whether a chip or the context is attached, focus into the text

events: chat-send (bubbles): detail { text, chips }; Enter or Send, with words while the conditions allow; with a host that holds what is attached (ChatHost.holds), also with no words and while the agent works when something is attached. The words stay until clear()
chat-chip-remove (bubbles): detail { chip }; the chip is taken off and focus goes back to the text
whenNotToUse: A note on a card (the note bubble).
accessibility: The text is labelled 'Message to the agent'. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line. Each chip's remove button is named 'Remove Card 12: <title>' or 'Remove Note: <text>', 24px square. The context chip is a button named by its label, with aria-expanded; opened, its lines are a list named by the label and controlled by it, and focus stays on the chip.
